name: docinfoshield
description: Word add-in that redacts sensitive information using a FastAPI + Microsoft Presidio backend

scripts.start: concurrently -n tsc,web,api,word -c blue,green,magenta,yellow "npm run watch" "npm run dev-server" "npm run api" "office-addin-debugging start manifest.xml"
scripts.start:servers: concurrently -n tsc,web,api -c blue,green,magenta "npm run watch" "npm run dev-server" "npm run api"
scripts.sideload: office-addin-dev-settings sideload manifest.xml desktop --app Word --document Document-To-Be-Redacted.docx
